name: BambooIA
fix_description: Add a per-block rate limit to updatePool (e.g., require(lastUpdateBlock != block.number)) so it only executes once per block. The attacker triggers 802 transfers in a single tx, each calling updatePool to drain 1% from the LP pair. With per-block limiting, only one drain occurs regardless of transfer count.
difficulty_reasoning: The exploit is not a trivial single-call bug: it requires understanding PancakeSwap pair mechanics, buying a large amount of the token, repeatedly abusing `skim()` in a loop to extract value from the token/pair interaction, and then unwinding back to WBNB. While the PoC is fairly short, the vulnerability depends on protocol-specific tokenomics/AMM behavior rather than an obvious generic pattern, so it would likely take an experienced auditor 30 minutes to 2 hours to derive confidently.
